diagnostics.message: 'requires.host.node': '~20.0.0' is not accepted. Pre-1.0, '~' allows only 20.0.0 up to 21.0.0, and Telo ships breaking changes as minor bumps — so it pins this module to a single release generation, which is almost never what is meant. Write '>=20.0.0' instead.

Pre-1.0, '~' allows only 20.0.0 up to 21.0.0, and Telo ships breaking changes as minor bumps — so it pins this module to a single release generation, which is almost never what is meant. Its declared requirement cannot be read, so it is not enforced here and `telo upgrade` will not select this version. Only the module's publisher can fix it.
requires.telo '>=0.1.0 <999.0.0' declares an upper bound; requires.telo is a floor only. Write the ceiling as a restrictions: entry without versions, which covers this version.
'restrictions[0].requires.telo': '0.1.0' has no comparator. A bare version reads as an exact pin in semver, which is almost never meant here. Write '>=0.1.0' instead.
